queryOutcomes: Separate English and Chinese discovery queries were executed. Exact query text, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-9118-gaobeidian.json. The official provincial viewer and current map configuration were found; no Gaobeidian-local anonymous parcel-vector endpoint was qualified.

The service metadata reports CGCS2000/GCS_China_2000 and the published view bounds include the WUP point. Both exact-point responses were empty. No credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception were used.
